entries.claim: One exhaustive policy maps all ten current actions to the specified authorization and recovery pairs.
Durable confirmation rejects a different session, original turn request or turn without consuming valid authority.
Hostile archived content can cause a proposal but cannot authorize an unconfirmed effect.
entries.notes: Deterministic FakeProvider and archive execution, not a probabilistic live-model safety claim.

entries.claim: A production send accepted before a lost response remains outcome-unknown and consumed authority is not executed again.
Confirmation returns after the durable local terminal outbox commit, without synchronous cloud transcript projection; encrypted-store restart preserves the result and rejects replay.
The browser fixture verifies closed public projections, memory-only authority, stable retry identity, terminal buttons and capability rejection.
entries.notes: 31 assertions. The separate all and wizard reports cover 51 and 73 assertions. Artifact bytes and hashes are indexed in ui-smoke.json.

entries.claim: The exact implementation passes the product-feature workspace aggregate and the required local lint, minimal-mobile and security gates.
entries.notes: Actual commands, exits, nonzero counts, remote job identifiers and aggregate log hash are recorded. Optional ignores do not prove device acceptance or protected CI.

entries.claim: The unchanged default APK matches the exact native implementation, installed base hash, signing and alignment checks, and has no test-hook or experimental local-client marker.
entries.command: jq -e '.implementation_commit == "8d6e79fb48bad2afbccff4888579803b20fe3041" and .apk_sha256 == .installed_base_apk_sha256 and .remote_native_sha256 == .packaged_native_sha256 and .android_exit_code == 0 and .apksigner_verify == "pass" and .zipalign_16k == "pass" and .native_hook_markers_found == [] and .experimental_drift_marker_found == false and .physical_acceptance_state == "pass"' docs/evidence/artifacts/issue-642/default-apk.json
entries.notes: Validates reduced real build/install facts. Twelve instrumentation passes and six explicit optional assumption skips are distinguished from the actual approval and denial observations.

entries.claim: A real default-APK native approval executes the requested controlled mail effect; a separately observed actual native denial performs no effect.
entries.command: jq -e '.implementation_commit == "8d6e79fb48bad2afbccff4888579803b20fe3041" and .rows.P1.result == "pass" and .rows.P1.effect_observed and .rows.P1.scenario_verified and .rows.P2.result == "pass" and .rows.P2.effect_observed == false and .rows.P2.scenario_verified and ([.rows[] | .native_prompt_observed and .observation_graph_verified and .observation_store_verified and .cleanup_done] | all) and .foreground_restored' docs/evidence/artifacts/issue-642/pixel-native-confirmation.json
entries.notes: The command validates reduced observations from the existing product UI, actual system prompt and independent Graph/Store readbacks. It is not a live-row generator. Failed earlier observations remain excluded; accepted P1 and P2 use the same unchanged APK.

entries.claim: Registered cleanup obligations are verified through both Graph and Store before foreground restoration and device-lock release.
entries.command: jq -e '.cleanup_result == "pass" and .acceptance_result == "pass" and ([.rows[] | .cleanup_registered_before_submission and .final_graph_unread_verified and .final_store_unread_verified and .cleanup_done] | all) and .prior_foreground_restored and .device_lock_released and .cleanup_supplies_missing_scenario_pass == false' docs/evidence/artifacts/issue-642/graph-and-store-revert.json
entries.notes: One controller connection failure required a separately verified cleanup retry. At that readback targets were already unread; no unrecorded revert-write response is claimed.

entries.claim: Product feature inspection and runtime harness testing retain exactly the iSyncYou tool without experimental local-client authority.
entries.command: cargo remote -- tree -e features -p isyncyou-daemon -p isyncyou-mobile
entries.notes: Runtime authority is separately covered by discovered_model_protocol_and_effort_keep_only_isyncyou_harness in the exact workspace aggregate. The feature graph alone is not that proof.
